items.title: Python Workers Reach GA on Cloudflare, with Questions About Cold Starts and Upstream Maintenance
items.blurb: Cloudflare has made Python Workers generally available, built on PEP 783 and on socket syscalls implemented over the Workers connect API. The announcement carries no performance figures.

items.title: Cloudflare Worker Previews: Per-Branch Environments for Workers
items.blurb: Cloudflare has introduced Worker Previews. This feature allows each Git branch to have its own isolated, production-like environment for a Worker. Each environment has a stable URL.

items.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 now available on AWS
items.blurb: AWS now offers Claude Sonnet 5.5, a smarter and more efficient Sonnet that delivers a clear leap forward on coding and knowledge work with at a lower cost per task for most work at faster speed.

items.title: Grok 4.7 is now available on Amazon Bedrock
items.blurb: Amazon Bedrock now supports SpaceXAI Grok 4.7, a frontier model built for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work, with US Geo and Global cross-Region inference.

items.title: Amazon EC2 Future-dated Capacity Reservations Now Supports Postponing Start Dates
items.blurb: Amazon EC2 Future-dated Capacity Reservations let you secure capacity up to 120 days in advance by specifying the capacity you need, the start date, and a commitment duration.

items.title: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) now supports retryable writes
items.blurb: For developers building MongoDB-compatible applications, retryable writes improve application resilience during transient errors such as network interruptions or primary failovers.

items.title: Amazon Rekognition Face Liveness now returns Feedback Codes
items.blurb: Amazon Rekognition Face Liveness now returns Feedback Codes that help customers understand why a liveness check received a low score and how users could retry successfully.
